item.title: Max Miller to stay on Ohio ballots despite pressure to drop out of race after domestic abuse allegations – live
item.summary: The House Republican has been disavowed by his own party amid allegations that he has been abusive toward his ex-wife and daughter Sign up for the Breaking News US email On Tuesday, Republican voters in South Carolina will have the opportunity to re-select their GOP nominee for the Senate race this November. This comes after the death of long-serving Senator Lindsey Graham last month. Graham had won the Republican nomination for the Senate seat he had held for 23 years. His sister, Darline Graham , was appointed to finish the final months of his term and is running to take his place as the GOP nominee. She’s also received Trump’s endorsement. Continue reading...
